questions.title: Enter privileged EXEC mode
questions.questionText: Which Cisco IOS command enters privileged EXEC mode?
questions.explanation: The enable command changes the device from user EXEC mode to privileged EXEC mode.

questions.title: VLAN trunk characteristics
questions.questionText: Which two statements correctly describe an IEEE 802.1Q trunk?
questions.explanation: An 802.1Q trunk carries traffic for multiple VLANs and normally tags frames except those belonging to the native VLAN.

options.text: It can carry traffic for multiple VLANs.
It tags VLAN traffic except native VLAN traffic by default.
It permits traffic from only one access VLAN.
It requires every endpoint to be a router.

questions.title: Purpose of a default gateway
questions.questionText: A host uses its default gateway to send traffic to a destination outside its local network.
questions.explanation: The default gateway forwards packets destined for remote networks.

questions.title: IPv4 routing-table command
questions.questionText: Enter the Cisco IOS command used to display the IPv4 routing table.
questions.explanation: The full command and its common abbreviation are accepted.
